title: Harness utilities
description: Datapack that adds 2 new enchantments to the happy ghast harness.
body:
Data pack that adds 2 new enchantments to the game that focus around utility with the happy ghast. These are obtained through archeaology at a new kind of fossil in the Nether, and can be applied to any harness.

# **Enchantments:**
-Supersonic: increases the speed of the happy ghast up to its max level of 3, at which the ghast moves a slightly over double base speed
-Reinforced: increases the armour of the happy ghast relative to the level, which has a max level fo 4. Each level corresponds to an armour set: level 1 being leather, level 2 being gold, level 3 being iron and level 4 being diamond.

# **Obtaining:**
Both enchantments can be found by brushing suspicious gravel around new suspicious fossils, the new fossils are found in soul sand valley biomes in the nether. Brushing can also result in other treasure.
